statement: Code SN (Subscriber Number) is an identifier for a subscriber of an insurance policy, unique for and usually assigned by the carrier; code XV (Health Plan Identifier) is a national unique health plan identifier required by the US Department of Health and Human Services, CMS; code MC is the patient Medicare number.
location: HL7 v2 table 0203, codes SN, XV, MC
inference: SN and MB are distinct typed roles (subscriber versus insured); XV identifies a plan, an organization-level role, not a person. Treating XV as a public payer/plan identifier is project inference.

notes: No value format stated for SN.
The XV regulatory status was not checked.

statement: Coverage.dependent is a unique identifier for a dependent under the coverage; Coverage.class.value is an alphanumeric string associated with an insurer-issued label (group or plan class); Coverage.identifier is a unique identifier assigned to this coverage. None has a stated value format.
location: FHIR R4 Coverage, elements dependent, class.value, identifier
inference: Dependent, group/plan class and coverage (policy) identifiers are separate roles from subscriberId; the first is person-level, the others describe a coverage that can be shared by many people. The latter is project inference.

notes: Only the Coverage element definitions were read; the last 9000 characters of the page were not.
Whether a bare coverage identifier is person-linked is not source-stated.

statement: Coverage.beneficiary is the party who benefits from the coverage and references a Patient; Coverage.subscriber is the party who owns the contractual relationship; Coverage.payor references the underwriter or payor Organization, Patient or RelatedPerson; Organization.identifier identifies the organization across systems.
location: FHIR R4 Coverage, elements beneficiary, subscriber, payor; Organization.identifier
inference: A payer or plan organization identifier names an organization, not a person; person-linked roles are beneficiary, subscriber and dependent. Payor can also be a person, so the organization reading depends on the referenced type.

notes: No example public payer identifiers or value formats were found in the pages read.
